in_sanskrit.name: Atigay
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Beyond Boundaries
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Atigay एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Atigay is derived from Sanskrit words 'ati' meaning 'beyond' and 'gaya' meaning 'boundaries'. This name signifies one who transcends all limits and barriers. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that the name Atigay was given to the celestial beings who were blessed with the power to go beyond the known universe. This name is a symbol of limitless potential and fearless exploration.
